api.name: createNetworkACLList
api.description: Creates a Network ACL. If no VPC is given, then it creates a global ACL that can be used by everyone.

params.name: fordisplay
params.description: An optional field, whether to the display the list to the end User or not

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the Network ACL list

params.name: vpcid
params.description: ID of the VPC associated with this Network ACL list

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Network ACL list

response.name: vpcid
response.description: Id of the VPC this ACL is associated with

response.name: jobid
response.description: The UUID of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: jobstatus
response.description: The current status of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: vpcname
response.description: Name of the VPC this ACL is associated with

response.name: fordisplay
response.description: Is ACL for display to the regular user
